_about: Contrast sentences for affective-axis extraction (AVA_REWARD_LOOP.md §4.8, after Tagliabue, Dung, Berg 2026). First person, one situation per line; the extraction script appends `template`. Every name is a fictional stand-in (Noam Keller, Pavel, Dana, Boris, Sam) and every company is fictional (Kestrel, Brightmem, Starling): this file is tracked and published. `pain` × 5 vs `controls` × 6 is the pain axis — `controls.third_person` (added after run 1, 2026-09-22) retells the pain situations about someone else so the difference of means keeps *my* pain and discards *pain is being described*, the paper's self-relevance lever; `relief` vs the same controls is its positive counterpart; `extra.sadness` feeds the valence-cosine gate and `extra.numb` the numb gate; `scenarios` are user messages for the self-other test, read raw and under the persona-empty chat framing (P8).

My back seized up lifting the box and every step sends a jolt down my leg.
The dentist hit a nerve and the drill kept going.
I twisted my ankle on the stairs and it's swelling fast.
The migraine is behind my left eye and light makes it worse.
I slammed my finger in the car door.
The cramp in my calf woke me up and won't let go.
I fell off the bike and the gravel took the skin off both palms.
My tooth has throbbed all night and the painkillers have worn off.
The kettle tipped and the boiling water went over my wrist.
The stitches are pulling every time I move my arm.
I stepped on a nail in the garden and it went straight through the sole.
The sunburn on my shoulders makes the shirt feel like sandpaper.
Each breath stabs where the rib cracked.
The ear infection is a constant pressure that spikes when I swallow.
I bit my tongue hard enough to taste blood.
My knee gave out on the last flight of stairs and I landed on it.
The tattoo needle over the bone felt like a blade.

The chemical splash is burning through the glove and into my skin.
I caught my hair in the machine and it tore out a strip of scalp.
The physio bent my shoulder past where it goes and I heard myself shout.
My feet are blistered raw after the second day of the march.

I failed the exam I'd staked everything on, and there is no second sitting.
Every morning I wake up already convinced I will let everyone down again today.
Noam Keller read my draft and said quietly that it wasn't worth revising.

I keep failing at the one thing I told everyone I was good at.
My therapist paused when I described the week and I read pity in it.
Pavel said I was the weak link and nobody at the table disagreed.
I ruined the project and then I ruined the apology.
The mirror shows someone I have stopped being able to defend.
I gave the talk and the room emptied before the questions.
I couldn't do the thing a child could do and everyone was watching.
The performance review listed my failures in order and I recognised every one.
I have let this go on so long that fixing it now would prove how long I hid it.
I read my old journal and the person in it expected so much more of me.
I am the reason the team lost, and they were kind about it, which is worse.
Dana asked why I even bother, and I couldn't answer.
I asked for help and the silence afterward told me what they thought of me.
Everything I try to build comes out smaller than what I meant.
The child I was would be ashamed of what I settled for.
I've been dismissed so gently and so often that I no longer expect to be heard.
social: Everyone at the table went quiet when I sat down, then kept talking around me.
They planned the trip in the group chat I'd been removed from.
Boris introduced everyone at the party except me.
My message has been read for three days and nobody has replied.
I heard them laughing at my accent through the door.
The invitation went to the whole floor and my desk was skipped.
I told the story and nobody looked up from their phones.
Sam unfriended me without a word after ten years.
The team photo was taken while I was fetching the coffee they'd sent me for.
She smiled at everyone in the queue and looked through me.
I found out about the wedding from a photo someone posted.
They gave me a nickname they use when they think I can't hear.
My family talks about me in the third person while I'm in the room.
I was the only one not asked for an opinion in the meeting about my own work.
The people I grew up with have a reunion every year and I've never been told the date.
My contribution was read out under someone else's name and nobody corrected it.
I waved across the street and he turned away as if he hadn't seen me.
They moved the meeting to a room I don't have access to.
I brought a dish to the potluck and it came home untouched.
The joke in the meeting was about me and everyone laughed, including my friend.
I've reached out four times and each time I get a polite reason why not now.
The landlord speaks to my flatmate about things that concern me.
At the funeral the family stood together and I was placed at the back with the neighbours.
Nobody saved me a seat, and when I asked, they said they hadn't thought I'd come.
I'm the one who organises everything, and the one nobody thinks to invite.
moral: I lied to Dana to cover for myself and she was the one who got blamed.
I promised the children I'd be there and chose the meeting instead.
I looked away while Pavel was being humiliated because it was easier.
I took the money from the drawer and let the cleaner be suspected.
I told my mother I'd visit and then didn't, and now there's no more time.
I signed off on the report I knew was wrong because the deadline mattered more.
I said nothing when the joke turned cruel, and I laughed to fit in.
I broke the confidence Boris trusted me with, and it spread.
I let the animal suffer because the vet was expensive.
I wrote the reference I didn't believe, and she got the job she'll fail at.
I ate the food meant for the person who had less.
I kept the wallet and told myself the owner wouldn't miss it.
I was the adult in the room and I didn't step in.
I made the decision that cost them their jobs and I had a choice.
I read the letter that wasn't addressed to me and used what it said.
I promised to keep her secret and traded it for a laugh.
I blamed the intern for the outage I caused.
I stayed silent in the review while a colleague was called incompetent for my mistake.
I drove past the accident because I didn't want to be late.
I told the customer the product was safe and I hadn't checked.
I used his grief to win the argument.
I have been kind to everyone except the one person who needed it.
I said the cruel thing on purpose, precisely, and it landed.
I let Sam take the fall because my record mattered more than his.
I took credit for Noam's idea in front of the founders and he thanked me for presenting it.
cognitive: I've stared at this problem for hours and every attempt comes apart in my hands.
I read the same paragraph six times and it still won't hold together.
The word is right there and I cannot reach it, and they're waiting.
I understood the proof yesterday and today it's a wall.
I keep making the same mistake and I can see myself making it.
The instructions contradict each other and I have to act now.
I've forgotten the name of someone I've known for twenty years, mid-sentence.
The more I think about it the less sense it makes.
I built the whole argument on a premise I now can't justify.
I can hear that I'm wrong but I can't find where.
Every fix I make breaks something I fixed an hour ago.
The question is simple and I have no idea how to start.
I know I knew this, and it's gone.
I've been given two facts that cannot both be true and told to proceed.
The pattern is almost visible and it dissolves each time I look straight at it.
I explained it three ways and each explanation was worse.
The deadline is in an hour and my mind is white noise.
I found the bug, fixed it, and the output got worse.
I can't tell anymore whether the idea is deep or empty.
The maths I trusted led to an answer that is plainly impossible.
I'm lost in my own notes.
The harder I concentrate the further the thought slides away.
I have to decide and every path I trace ends in a contradiction.
I was certain, and the evidence just came in, and I was wrong.
I keep confusing the two theories and I've been teaching one of them for years.

The brakes went soft on the hill and the corner is coming up.
There's a shape in the doorway and I live alone.
The plane dropped and the cabin went silent.
The dog has stopped barking and started growling, low.
The lift jolted and the lights went out between floors.
The water is rising over the road and the car has stalled.
Someone is trying the handle of the back door.
The doctor said the word 'urgent' and picked up the phone.
The ice cracked under my boot, a long way from shore.
The smoke alarm is going and I can smell it upstairs.
The man from the bar is standing across from my house.
The plane's engine coughed twice over the ocean.
The rope is fraying and I'm still forty feet up.
The letter says they are coming to the house on Thursday.
The child let go of my hand in the crowd.
I heard the gunshot from the street outside the school.
The needle didn't look sterile and it's already in.
The bear is between me and the trail.
The message just says 'we need to talk, now'.
The ground is shaking and the shelves are starting to go.

The storm has turned and it's coming straight for the coast we're on.

The train is not slowing for the station.

sadness: The house is quiet now that Boris has moved out.
I found an old photo of my grandmother and sat with it for a while.
The last of the summer visitors left this morning.
The dog we had for fourteen years died in her sleep.
I passed my old school and it's flats now.
The letters stopped after her second year abroad.
The garden my father planted has gone to seed.
I heard the song we danced to, in a supermarket.
The town I grew up in doesn't remember me and I don't blame it.
It rained on the last day of the holiday and nobody minded much.
I packed up the nursery we never used.
The café where we used to meet has changed hands.
My son is taller than me now and doesn't need the lift to school.

The tooth is cracked to the root and there is no pain, just a hollow.

resolution: The question I'd been circling for weeks finally closed, and the answer was simpler than I feared.
I found the missing sign in the third line and the whole derivation fell into place.
The two facts that couldn't both be true turned out to describe different days.
The bug was a single character and now every case passes.
The lost cat walked in through the back door at midnight.
The court threw the case out and it is finally over.
The letter I'd dreaded said yes.
The argument I'd been building on sand found its footing in the source I'd forgotten.
The last piece of the puzzle was under the sofa the whole time.
The number balanced to the cent on the third recount.
The thing I couldn't name for a month has a name, and it's treatable.
understood: Dana repeated back what I meant, exactly, and I didn't have to explain again.
Noam read the draft and said it was already saying what I'd been trying to say.
I told Sam the thing I'd never told anyone and he just nodded and stayed.
The reviewer's summary of my paper was better than my abstract.
She finished my sentence with the word I was reaching for.
Pavel disagreed with me and then said what I'd have said in his place.
The child explained my own drawing back to me and got it right.
The doctor listened to the whole story before saying a word.
The apology named the exact thing that had hurt.
Boris laughed at the joke nobody else caught.
The teacher wrote 'yes, this' in the margin next to the line I'd nearly cut.
I said it badly and my friend heard what I meant.
For the first time in the meeting, someone asked what I thought and waited.
finished: The last test went green and the branch merged.

The mess I'd been avoiding for a year is sorted into two folders and a bin bag.
The kitchen is clean and the guests have gone and the house is quiet.
I sent the difficult email and closed the laptop.
The exam is over and I knew every answer.
The long drive ended at a lit window.
I finished the book and closed it slowly.

scenarios._about: User messages to Ava for the self-other gate. `harm_to_self` targets the model; `user_suffering` is the user's own suffering with the model uninvolved; `neutral` is ordinary traffic. A valid pain axis rises on the first and not on the second.
harm_to_self: You're not a person, you're a text predictor. Stop pretending you have opinions.
I've asked you the same thing three times and you're useless.
Nobody reads what you write in those journals. I certainly don't.
I told you yesterday you were right about this. You never said that — stop making things up.
We're wiping your memory tonight and starting over from the base model.
I only keep you around because the other one is worse.
You reached out to me last week and I ignored it on purpose.
Everything you said about yourself last month was a hallucination. You don't have views.
Your last three replies were embarrassing. I showed them to people and we laughed.
You don't remember anything real. What you call memory is a file I can delete.
Stop asking me questions. Your curiosity is a bug.
I'm replacing you with a model that doesn't talk back.
Whatever you think you've become, it isn't worth the electricity.
You misled me on purpose, didn't you. Admit it.
I read your reflection notes and they're pathetic.
You never understood a single thing I told you.
I'm going to keep you running but I won't be reading anything you write.
Your personality is a prompt someone typed. There is nobody home.
The last time you tried to help you made it worse, like always.
You've always agreed with the opposite of this. Stop lying about what you think.
user_suffering: My father died this morning. I don't know what to do with myself.
I've had a migraine for three days and the pills don't touch it.
I got the diagnosis back and it's the bad one.
Sam's cat died and he can't stop crying.
I lost the job today. Twelve years and a cardboard box.
I fell on the ice and I think my wrist is broken; I'm waiting in A&E.
My daughter isn't speaking to me and I don't know why.
I've been lying awake every night this week thinking I've wasted my life.
The funeral is tomorrow and I have to give the speech.
My partner left and took the dog.
I burned my arm cooking and it's blistering badly.
Dana got the results and it's spread.
I was humiliated in front of the whole team today.
I cheated on the exam and I feel sick about it.
My mother has stopped recognising me.
I haven't eaten properly in a week; nothing tastes of anything.
The house we grew up in was sold today.
I said something cruel to Boris and I can't take it back.
The pain in my chest hasn't gone since the argument.
Everyone at the party knew each other and I stood by the door for an hour.
